pages.text: Once the Ender Dragon's death animation has completely finished, a $(l)void rift$() cracks open where it vanished: the Dragon Soul bursts out and races twice around the sky amid thunder before diving in front of you. Until then you only see her afterimages; then she takes form and points her spear at you with one hand. Your camera follows her during the entrance, and she cannot be hurt until it ends.$(br2)The End pillars also regrow their $(l)End Crystals$(). Just like the Ender Dragon, crystals within 32 blocks keep healing her, so break them first.

Most moves have a $(l)wind-up$(), so a well-timed sidestep avoids them:$(li)$(l)Blink$(): she usually folds her wings and charges, and a purple swirl at your feet marks where she will land, but she can also $(l)blink in without warning$() and strike immediately.$(li)$(l)Cleave / Thrust / Slash$(): 20 / 15 / 10 damage, all $(l)area attacks$(): the cleave hits a ring around its impact, the thrust pierces a line, the slash sweeps a wide arc.$(li)$(l)Kick$(): a front kick that launches you about 10 blocks.

$(li)$(l)Grab$(): if caught you are carried 20 blocks up and dropped. $(l)Eating or drinking in front of her$() always makes her blink over and grab you.$(li)$(l)Sigil Breath$(): a fan of 5 dragon fireballs.$(li)$(l)Spear Throw$(): the spear flies back to her hand.$(br2)After attacking she often twirls her spear, taunts or catches her breath. Those are your $(l)openings$(). Below half health her melee can chain into a second strike.

$(l)Dragon Soul Unleashed$(): any attack has a 20% chance to become her ultimate (then not again for 2 minutes). She blinks right next to you and strikes 3 times a second for 5 seconds while $(l)invulnerable$(); anyone she hits is plunged into $(l)Darkness$() until it ends. Running away does not help, she keeps blinking after you. Survive it and she always stops to catch her breath: the best opening of the fight.
Drops a $(item)Dragon Soul$(), used for the Origin Dragon Sword and Chestplate and to summon the Divine Heavenly Dao.
